parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body||{}; const token=String(b.token||'').trim(),slotId=String(b.slotId||'').trim(); if(!/^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$/.test(token)||!/^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$/.test(slotId)) throw new Error('token ou slotId invalide'); return [{json:{token,slotId}}];

parameters.query:
WITH rdv AS (SELECT * FROM rendez_vous WHERE token_gestion='{{$json.token}}'::uuid AND statut IN ('CONFIRME','EN_ATTENTE') FOR UPDATE),
newslot AS (SELECT * FROM creneaux WHERE id='{{$json.slotId}}'::uuid AND statut='DISPONIBLE' AND places_reservees<capacite FOR UPDATE),
valid AS (SELECT r.id AS rdv_id,r.creneau_id AS old_slot,n.id AS new_slot,n.service_id,n.site_id FROM rdv r CROSS JOIN newslot n),
reserve_new AS (UPDATE creneaux SET places_reservees=places_reservees+1,statut=CASE WHEN places_reservees+1>=capacite THEN 'COMPLET' ELSE statut END,updated_at=now() WHERE id IN (SELECT new_slot FROM valid) RETURNING id),
release_old AS (UPDATE creneaux SET places_reservees=GREATEST(places_reservees-1,0),statut=CASE WHEN statut='COMPLET' THEN 'DISPONIBLE' ELSE statut END,updated_at=now() WHERE id IN (SELECT old_slot FROM valid) RETURNING id),
upd AS (UPDATE rendez_vous r SET creneau_id=v.new_slot,service_id=v.service_id,site_id=v.site_id,statut='REPLANIFIE',updated_at=now() FROM valid v WHERE r.id=v.rdv_id RETURNING r.*),
h AS (INSERT INTO historique_rendez_vous(rendez_vous_id,action,ancien_statut,nouveau_statut,details) SELECT id,'REPLANIFICATION','CONFIRME','REPLANIFIE',jsonb_build_object('nouveau_creneau',creneau_id) FROM upd),
n AS (INSERT INTO notifications(rendez_vous_id,type,canal,destinataire,statut) SELECT id,'REPLANIFICATION','EMAIL',email,'A_ENVOYER' FROM upd WHERE email IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING)
SELECT u.id,u.reference,u.statut,u.token_gestion,c.debut,c.fin,s.code AS service,si.code AS site FROM upd u JOIN creneaux c ON c.id=u.creneau_id JOIN services s ON s.id=u.service_id JOIN sites si ON si.id=u.site_id;
